chapters.title: The Discovery
content: Kei Nagai is a high school student who dreams of becoming a doctor.
He is intelligent, cold, and somewhat detached from others.
Kei is hit by a truck while trying to save a classmate.
He survives the accident but is revealed to be an Ajin.
Ajin are immortal beings who cannot die and can summon invisible beings called IBM.
The discovery changes Kei's life forever.
The government places a large bounty on all Ajin.
Kei is wanted dead or alive by the authorities.
He goes on the run to avoid capture and experimentation.
Kei learns about the hatred and fear humans have for Ajin.
He must survive in a world that wants to destroy him.
Kei's cold and calculating nature helps him survive.
He is determined to protect himself at all costs.
Kei's journey as an Ajin has just begun.

chapters.title: The Hunted
content: The government begins a massive manhunt for Kei.
Ajin are considered threats to national security.
Kei uses his intelligence to evade capture.
He disguises himself and moves from place to place.
Kei learns about the history of Ajin persecution.
Ajin have been hunted and experimented on for centuries.
Kei meets other Ajin who have escaped from the government.
They tell him about the horrors of the Ajin experiments.
Kei is determined to never be captured.
He trains to control his IBM (Invisible Black Matter).
The IBM is a powerful and deadly weapon.
Kei learns to summon and control his IBM.
He becomes more confident and capable.
Kei's survival instincts are sharpened.

chapters.title: The IBM
content: Kei masters the ability to summon his IBM.
The IBM is a terrifying and powerful entity.
He can only summon it for short periods of time.
The IBM is invisible to normal humans.
Only Ajin and certain individuals can see the IBM.
Kei uses his IBM to defend himself against enemies.
He learns that Ajin can merge their IBMs together.
The combined power of multiple Ajin is incredible.
Kei's IBM takes on a unique shape and form.
He is one of the most powerful Ajin alive.
Kei's abilities attract attention from all sides.
The government wants to use him as a weapon.
Other Ajin want to recruit him for their cause.
Kei remains independent and self-reliant.

chapters.title: The Ajin Community
content: Kei meets a group of Ajin living in hiding.
The Ajin community is small and secretive.
They welcome Kei into their group.
The community is led by a man named Tanaka.
Tanaka is kind and compassionate toward his fellow Ajin.
He believes that Ajin and humans can coexist.
Kei is skeptical of Tanaka's idealism.
He believes that humans will always hate Ajin.
The Ajin community is constantly on the move.
They are hunted by the government and other forces.
Kei must decide if he wants to stay with them.
He values his independence over safety.
The Ajin community is a temporary refuge.
Kei prepares to continue his journey alone.

chapters.title: The Hunters
content: A group of human hunters begins hunting Ajin.
The hunters are paid by the government for each capture.
They are ruthless and have no empathy for Ajin.
The hunters use advanced technology and weapons.
They specialize in capturing Ajin alive.
Kei is targeted by the most dangerous hunters.
He must use all his skills to evade them.
The hunters capture some of Kei's friends.
Kei is determined to save them from the hunters.
He tracks the hunters to their hideout.
Kei uses his IBM to attack the hunters.
The battle is brutal and bloody.
Kei saves his friends but is deeply traumatized.
He realizes that the hunt will never end.

chapters.title: The General
content: Kei encounters a powerful and dangerous Ajin named Sato.
Sato is a former soldier who was experimented on.
He is the leader of a terrorist organization.
Sato is an extremist who hates all humans.
He believes that Ajin should rule the world.
Sato is charismatic and persuasive.
He tries to recruit Kei into his organization.
Kei refuses to join Sato's cause.
Sato is patient and willing to wait.
He is the most powerful Ajin in the world.
Sato is a master of strategy and manipulation.
He uses violence to achieve his goals.
Kei is both fascinated and horrified by Sato.
The two Ajin are destined to clash.

chapters.title: The Ideology
content: Sato explains his ideology to Kei.
He believes that Ajin are superior to humans.
Ajin are immortal and cannot be killed.
Humans are weak and expendable.
Sato wants to create a world ruled by Ajin.
He will destroy any human who opposes him.
Kei disagrees with Sato's beliefs.
He does not believe in violence and genocide.
Kei still values human life.
He is caught between two worlds.
The conflict between Kei and Sato is inevitable.
Kei must find a way to stop Sato's madness.
He must protect both humans and Ajin.
The future of the world depends on his decisions.

chapters.title: The Attack
content: Sato launches a massive terrorist attack on the city.
His organization is well-armed and well-organized.
The attack causes chaos and destruction.
Many innocent people are killed.
The government is powerless to stop Sato.
Sato has a plan to destroy the entire city.
Kei decides to stop Sato at all costs.
He enters the city and searches for Sato.
The two Ajin finally meet face to face.
Sato is amused by Kei's determination.
He offers Kei one last chance to join him.
Kei refuses and attacks Sato.
The battle between the two Ajin begins.
The fate of the city hangs in the balance.

chapters.title: The Battle
content: Kei and Sato fight in the ruins of the city.
Both are immortal and cannot die.
The battle is brutal and savage.
They use their IBMs to attack each other.
Kei is outmatched by Sato's experience and skill.
He uses his intelligence to level the playing field.
Sato is unpredictable and dangerous.
He enjoys the violence and chaos.
The battle goes on for hours.
Kei is wounded many times but always recovers.
He refuses to give up or surrender.
Kei's determination and resilience are tested.
He finally manages to outsmart Sato.
The battle comes to a close.

chapters.title: The Victory
content: Kei defeats Sato and stops his attack.
He saves the city and its people from destruction.
Sato is captured by the government.
Kei is hailed as a hero by the people.
He is given a new life and a new identity.
Kei is no longer hunted by the government.
He becomes a symbol of hope for all Ajin.
Kei's actions bring peace between humans and Ajin.
He continues to advocate for Ajin rights.
Kei has found a new purpose in life.
He is no longer alone and isolated.
Kei has friends and allies who support him.
The conflict between humans and Ajin is over.
Kei's journey has come to an end.

chapters.title: The Aftermath
content: Kei reflects on his journey as an Ajin.
He has grown and changed immensely.
Kei is no longer the cold and detached person he was.
He has learned to care for others.
Kei's experiences have shaped him into a leader.
He continues to fight for peace and equality.
The world is slowly becoming a better place.
Ajin are no longer feared and persecuted.
Kei's story is an inspiration to everyone.
He proves that even a monster can be a hero.
Kei's journey is a testament to the human spirit.
He shows that change is possible.
The world has a new understanding of Ajin.
Kei's legacy will last forever.
